status.name: up-to-date
status.description: The running version equals the latest version.

status.name: newer-than-latest
status.description: A running version newer than the manifest is up to date.

status.name: prerelease-to-release
status.description: A prerelease is older than the release with the same core version.

status.name: required
status.description: The running version is older than minimumVersion.

status.name: minimum-version-met
status.description: The running version equals minimumVersion: the update is optional.

status.name: blocked
status.description: A known component does not satisfy a requirement.

status.name: requirement-unknown
status.description: Requirements on components whose version is unknown are not evaluated.

status.name: blocked-takes-precedence
status.description: blocked is reported even if the update would be required.

status.name: unsupported-platform
status.description: The manifest has no entry for the current platform.

status.name: unsupported-platform-when-up-to-date
status.description: A missing platform entry is an error even when the running version is the latest.
